title: Modified NEBNext VarSkip Short SARS-CoV-2 Library Prep for Illumina Platforms
author: Padmini Ramachandran
materials: The presence of genomic DNA or carry-over products can interfere with sequencing accuracy, particularly for low copy targets. Therefore, it is important to carry out the appropriate no template control (NTC) reactions to demonstrate that positive reactions are meaningful. We have also verified cDNA synthesis using the Invitrogen™ SuperScript™ IV First-Strand Synthesis System (Catalog number:18091200), as described in the SNAP protocol with modifications (random hexamers, RT incubation of 30 min.).
Gently mix and spin down reagents. Prepare the split pool cDNA amplification reactions as described below: For Pool Set A: For Pool Set B:

Based on the viral load in the sample, you will see a spectrum of fragment profiles. If there is a single peak around 400-600 bp, the clean-up step can be omitted and you can proceed directly to library preparation using Illumina DNA Prep https://www.protocols.io/edit/modified-illumina-dna-prep-m-tagmentation-library-b2yzqfx6 If there is not a single peak, check the amplicon size distributions. If there are lots of smaller peaks, for example, we typically see one at 44, 75, 128, and 213, these PCR reaction pools need to be cleaned up. Follow the cleanup protocol and prepare libraries using the Ultra II DNA workflow by NEB Next ARTIC SARS-CoV-2 Library Prep Kit (Illumina). If you are not able to perform the PCR pool assessment above, proceed to PCR cleanup and prepare libraries using the Ultra II DNA workflow by NEB Next ARTIC SARS-CoV-2 Library Prep Kit (Illumina).

steps.title: Prepare cDNA Synthesis Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare the cDNA synthesis reaction using LunaScript RT SuperMix reagent. Use 4.5 µl of cDNA input; if using less, supplement with nuclease-free water to reach a final volume of 4.5 µl.

substeps.instruction: Gently mix and spin down the LunaScript RT SuperMix reagent.
Flick tubes or pipet up and down 10 times to mix, then perform a quick spin.

steps.title: Thermocycle cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Incubate reactions in a thermocycler with the heated lid set to 105°C using the following program:

substeps.instruction: Primer Annealing: 25°C for 2 minutes (1 cycle)
cDNA Synthesis: 55°C for 20 minutes (1 cycle)
Heat Inactivation: 95°C for 1 minute (1 cycle)
Hold: 4°C (infinite)

steps.title: Perform cDNA Amplification
steps.instruction: Set up cDNA amplification reactions (ideally in a different room from cDNA synthesis to minimize contamination).

substeps.instruction: Flick tubes or pipet up and down 10 times to mix, followed by a quick spin.

Incubate in a thermocycler with the heated lid set to 105°C using the following program: Initial Denaturation at 98°C for 30 seconds (1 cycle); Denature at 95°C for 15 seconds (35 cycles); Annealing/Extension at 63°C for 5 minutes (35 cycles); Hold at 4°C (infinite).

steps.title: Combine and Assess cDNA Amplicons
steps.instruction: Combine Pool A and Pool B PCR reactions for each sample.

substeps.instruction: Assess quantity of the cDNA amplicon using the Qubit HS kit (1 µL of each combined pool).
Assess size of the cDNA amplicon using Agilent TapeStation System, Bioanalyzer, or similar fragment analyzer.

steps.title: Clean Up cDNA Amplicons
steps.instruction: Perform a bead-based cleanup of the combined PCR reaction using NEBNext Sample Purification Beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads to resuspend.
Add 20 µL (0.8X) resuspended beads to the combined PCR reaction; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times or vortexing for 3-5 seconds on high.
Incubate at room temperature for at least 5 minutes.
Place on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then discard supernatant.
Add 200 µL 80% freshly prepared ethanol while on the stand; incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then discard supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of two washes), ensuring all visible liquid is removed.
Air dry beads on the magnetic stand for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry; beads should remain dark brown and glossy).
Remove from stand and elute DNA by adding 28 µL 0.1X TE (or 27 µL 0.1X TE if not assessing cDNA in Step 19).
Mix by pipetting 10 times or vortexing; incubate for at least 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then transfer 26 µL (or 25 µL if not assessing cDNA) to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: Final cDNA Amplicon Quality Control
steps.instruction: Assess the cleaned cDNA amplicon concentration and size.

substeps.instruction: Use a Qubit fluorometer to check concentration (proceed if ≥ 0.2 ng/µl).
Confirm 400 bp size using Bioanalyzer or TapeStation (for Bioanalyzer, dilute 10-fold with 0.1X TE and run 2 µL on a DNA High Sensitivity ScreenTape).

steps.title: End Prep and Adaptor Ligation
steps.instruction: Perform library preparation using the Ultra II DNA workflow (NEBNext ARTIC SARS-CoV-2 Library Prep Kit cat# E7650S/L and Multiplex Oligos cat# E6440S/L).

substeps.instruction: Add components to a sterile nuclease-free tube.
Mix by pipetting the entire volume (25 µl) up and down 10 times using a 100 µl or 200 µl pipette, then quick spin.
Run the thermocycler program (as specified in the kit).
Add components directly to the End Prep Reaction Mixture (do not premix adaptor with Ligation Master Mix).
Mix the ligation reaction by pipetting the entire volume (40 µl) up and down 10 times using a 100 µl or 200 µl pipette, then quick spin.
Incubate at 20°C for 15 minutes in a thermocycler with the heated lid off.

steps.title: USER Enzyme Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the ligation mixture with USER enzyme (required for non-indexed Adaptors).

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 µL (red or blue) USER Enzyme to the ligation mixture.
Mix well and incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes with the heated lid set to ≥ 47°C.

steps.title: Clean Up Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform a bead-based cleanup of the adaptor ligation reaction.

substeps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads to resuspend.
Add 43 µL (0.9X) resuspended beads to the reaction; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times or vortexing for 3-5 seconds on high.
Incubate on bench top at room temperature for at least 5 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then discard supernatant.
Perform two washes with 200 µL 80% freshly prepared ethanol (30 seconds incubation each), discarding supernatant after each.
Air dry beads on the magnetic stand for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry).
Remove from stand and elute DNA by adding 10 µL 0.1X TE.
Mix by pipetting 10 times or vortexing; incubate for at least 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then transfer 7.5 µL to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: Index PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification using NEBNext Oligo kit index primers (10 µM combined, 96-well plate format).

substeps.instruction: Add components to a sterile strip tube.
Mix by pipetting the entire volume (20 μl) up and down 10 times using a 100 μl pipette, then quick spin.
Perform PCR amplification in a thermocycler using specified cycling conditions.

steps.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a final bead-based cleanup of the PCR reaction.

substeps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads to resuspend.
Add 22.5 µL (0.9X) resuspended beads to the PCR reaction; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times or vortexing for 3-5 seconds on high.
Incubate on bench top at room temperature for at least 5 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then discard supernatant.
Perform two washes with 200 µL 80% freshly prepared ethanol (30 seconds incubation each), discarding supernatant after each.
Air dry beads on the magnetic stand for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry).
Remove from stand and elute DNA by adding 17 µL 0.1X TE.
Mix by pipetting 10 times or vortexing; incubate for at least 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then transfer 15 µL to a new PCR tube and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Final Library Quality Control
steps.instruction: Check the final library size distribution using an Agilent Bioanalyzer or TapeStation.

substeps.instruction: Dilute sample if necessary before loading.
Verify a peak size of approximately 520 bp.
